title: Safe Deposit Boxes: box sizes and the branches where each size is installed
content:
## Scope

This quick reference covers the Safe Deposit Boxes product line. It records two facts for each of the six official box sizes: the interior dimensions of the box, and whether that size is installed in the vault of each branch. Dimensions are interior measurements in inches.

## Interior dimensions

| Official box size | Interior height (inches) | Interior width (inches) | Interior depth (inches) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 3 | 5 | 24 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 3 | 10 | 24 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 5 | 10 | 24 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 10 | 10 | 24 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 10 | 15 | 24 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 10 | 20 | 24 |

Reading the table: the two figures in each size name are the interior height followed by the interior width, and every size has the same interior depth of 24 inches.

## Installation by branch

The table states, for each branch vault, whether a given box size is installed there.

| Branch | 3x5 | 3x10 | 5x10 | 10x10 | 10x15 | 10x20 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Greensboro Main Office | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed |
| Winston-Salem Reynolda Road | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed |
| Charlotte SouthPark | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed |
| Raleigh North Hills | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Not installed |
| Greenville Main Street | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Not installed |
| Roanoke Market Square | Installed | Installed | Installed | Installed | Not installed | Not installed |

## Points of reading

**Which sizes are installed at every branch?** The 3x5, 3x10, 5x10 and 10x10 Safe Deposit Box sizes are installed at all six branches.

**Where is the 10x15 Safe Deposit Box installed?** At every branch except Roanoke Market Square.

**Where is the 10x20 Safe Deposit Box installed?** Only at Greensboro Main Office, Winston-Salem Reynolda Road and Charlotte SouthPark.

**Which branches carry the full range of six sizes?** Greensboro Main Office, Winston-Salem Reynolda Road and Charlotte SouthPark.

**Is a 10x10 box deeper than a 3x5 box?** No. The two differ in height and width only; both are 24 inches deep.
